_comment: API that cua JMS, trich xuat tu ma JS cua web JMS ngay 2026-11-04 (xem api-recon.md muc 6). Gateway: https://jmsgw.jtexpress.vn, tien to dich vu operatingplatform. Xac thuc bang header authToken (YL_TOKEN), khong phai cookie.

batch_dict.note: Tu dien loai chuyen hoan cho trang batch: query current=1&size=999, tra ve danh sach {returnType, code}

batch_import.note: Upload file Excel mau len JMS (trang batch, nut Nhap file) - CAN multipart/form-data, cau noi hien chi gui JSON nen cho nay lam sau khi co token that de test

batch_query.note: Trang batch (MutilReturnBack2) - tra cuu toi da 200 ma/lan: payload {waybillNos: [...]}, tra ve mang dong {waybillNo, returnType, enteringFlag (1=duoc, 2=khong), remark, receiverName, receiverDetailedAddress}

batch_save.note: Trang batch - luu sau khi loc: payload la MANG [{waybillNo, rebackTypeCode}], rebackTypeCode = ma loai chuyen hoan da chon

batch_template.note: Tai file Excel mau cua trang batch (tra ve file, khong phai JSON) - cau noi hien tra ve dang text nen tinh nang tai mau lam sau

return_save_1.note: Luu dang ky Hoan lan 1 (reqAdd) - payload = data tim kiem + cac truong reback* (xem index.html)

return_save_2.note: Luu dang ky Hoan lan 2 (registerSecondReback) - payload giong return_save_1, applyTypeCode=6

return_search.note: Dang ky chuyen hoan - Tim kiem: query waybillNo + applyTypeCode (4=Tra lai/Hoan lan 1, 6=Hoan lan 2)

signfor_query.note: Tra ky nhan CSKH: payload {keywordList: [ma...], typeEnum: 'WAYBILL'}

track_csswork.note: Tra hanh trinh - viec CSKH: payload {keyword: ma, trackingTypeEnum: loai}

track_matter.note: Tra hanh trinh - kien van de: payload {current: 1, size: 100, waybillId: ma}

track_query.note: Tra hanh trinh - thong tin don: payload la MANG [{id: ma}]
